sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Social Commerce via Short Video Platforms

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Marshall Islands and the United States (economic and investment-related provisions)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: RMI Code Title 27, Business Corporations Act, as amended; Non-Resident Domestic Corporation Act, 2009, as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act, 2012 (P.L. 2011-175), as amended, and accompanying AML/CFT Regulations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Beneficial Ownership Declaration and Certified Passport Copy of UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public and Competent Authority in the UBO's Country of Residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney Appointing the Licensed Registered Agent
Certified Copy of the Parent Company's Constitutional Documents and Current Registry Extract
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relevant Foreign Corporate Registry or Parent Company Secretary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing for Corporate Shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate Registry in the Shareholder's Jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit watchlist, U.S. OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, and related domestic sanctions lists. Enhanced due diligence and adverse-media checks are required for PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, and politically exposed commercial counterparties.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Registrar of Corporations e-Filing Portal (administered through licensed registered agents)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the statutory language for corporate names. No mandatory local script is required. Names submitted in non-Roman scripts require a certified transliteration into English for registry indexing.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 30 days of a name-rejection notice, the applicant, through its licensed registered agent, may file a written appeal with the RMI Registrar of Corporations stating legal grounds, supporting evidence, and at least two alternative names. If the Registrar upholds the rejection, the applicant may seek judicial review in the RMI High Court within 14 days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office address is not permissible as the statutory registered office. A licensed registered agent in the Marshall Islands must maintain a physical office in Majuro or Ebeye for service of process. The business may otherwise operate remotely without local commercial substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; estimated annual probability below 10% for a non-resident low-risk social-commerce company, subject to AML/CFT supervisory discretion.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance search and reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI Registrar of Corporations / Licensed Registered Agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent appointment and registered office fee (first year)
UBO/AML/CFT due diligence and compliance package
Notarization, apostille, and consular legalization bundle
Corporate kit, bylaws, share certificates, and seals

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (Title 24, Marshall Islands Revised Code), especially §§ 24.101–24.204 (incorporation, registered office and agent, directors and officers); Articles of Incorporation filed under § 24.109.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Business Registry Division, Ministry of Finance and Banking
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None. The Business Corporations Act imposes no minimum paid-up capital; the Board may issue shares for such lawful consideration as it determines. No escrow account requirement applies to non-resident business corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporator and sole subscriber hereby subscribes to and confirms the issuance of the authorized common shares, with no mandated paid-up capital, and that the Board may accept any lawful consideration in exchange. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation shall be located at [registered office address], Republic of the Marshall Islands, and [name] is appointed as registered agent for service of process. RESOLVED, that [Director A], [Director B], and [Director C] are appointed as the initial Board of Directors to serve until their successors are elected. RESOLVED, that [Name] is appointed President, [Name] Secretary, and [Name] Treasurer, and such officers are authorized to execute all documents to open TikTok Shop retail accounts and complete corporate banking.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Business Registry Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written name availability request to the Companies Registry, either directly or through a licensed registered agent, for the proposed corporate name. If available, reserve the name for a non-extendable period of 60 days. The request must clearly state the chosen name and the intended corporate suffix 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or 'Limited'.
required_dossiers: Identity document of incorporator or licensed agent engagement letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as confusingly similar or prohibited, resubmit an alternative name without additional substantive change; the reservation fee is credited once.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent / corporate service provider in the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation specifying the corporate name, registered office (street address) in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, name and address of the registered agent, purpose (including social media commerce via TikTok Shop and ISIC 4791 retail activities), authorized share structure, and the names of the initial subscribers. Execute the document before a notary or by the incorporator in accordance with § 24.109.
required_dossiers: Subscriber lender authorisation / power of attorney if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries a substantive or formal defect, amend and re-execute the Articles promptly; a cure letter addressing the query must be submitted within 15 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission, stamp payment, and issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Business Registry Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Articles of Incorporation through the licensed registered agent, together with the registration cover sheet and the filing fee of USD 250. The Registrar will review the instrument for compliance with the Business Corporations Act, and upon acceptance will issue a Certificate of Incorporation and certifify the corporate charter.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected, correct the specific deficiency noted in the Registrar's notice and resubmit within 30 days; late refilings attract no penalty but a fresh fee may apply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation of corporate minute book and share subscription records
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Authorized by the incorporated company, the corporate secretary shall prepare the initial ledger, register share subscriptions, and record the subscribers' names, number of shares, and consideration paid. All entries must be kept in the statute-registered office or with the registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a share subscription discrepancy is found, execute a corrective board resolution and amend the register; no government filing is required for share capital amendments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board resolution and officer appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the corporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the initial board meeting or obtain unanimous written consent. Adopt the pro-forma first board resolution approving share issuance, adopting the registered office/agent, appointing directors and officers, and authorizing the officers to register the TikTok Shop retail business, open payment-rail accounts (TikTok Shop Payout and Wise B2B), and execute all required agreements.
required_dossiers: Written consent to action without meeting or meeting minutes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a jurisdictional authority denies reliance on the board resolution, re-issue a curative resolution under the Business Corporations Act and if necessary file a corrected statement with the Registrar.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable; no industrial licensing board authorizes non-resident social commerce under ISIC 4791 in the Marshall Islands. Any incidental warehouse use would fall under municipal business license regulation, not an industry-specific industrial permit.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None (statutory exemption for foreign-sales e-commerce); if a physical retail store is later opened, a Municipal Business License from the respective town/jurisdiction would be required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMIEPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (Category D-3) for pure e-commerce retail activity with no onsite industrial processing, wastewater discharge, or hazardous waste generation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable in the exempt category. Should a warehouse or fulfilment center be added, the activity must comply with the RMIEPA's wastewater effluent standards (no discharge into lagoon waters), volatile organic compound thresholds under the Clean Air Act, and solid waste handling rules; a simplified environmental registration with a waste management plan would be triggered.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable where no physical premises exist in the Marshall Islands. If an office or warehouse is established, a Fire Safety Certificate from the Marshall Islands Fire Department and a structural load inspection certificate from the Ministry of Public Works are required, along with a workplace health and safety clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Customs Division, Ministry of Finance; official portal: https://www.finance.gov.mh
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident business corporations are exempt from Marshall Islands income tax and are not subject to VAT (no VAT regime exists). No TIN or VAT ID is issued for such entities. For evidentiary purposes, the corporation may apply for a Certificate of Non-Resident Tax Exemption from the Ministry of Finance, submitting the Articles of Incorporation, Foreign Investment Permit (if applicable), and a director's resolution confirming offshore activity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections are available under Marshall Islands law. The tax classification is fixed by statute: a non-resident business corporation is treated as a tax-exempt foreign entity. No alternative domestic classification can be elected.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No National VAT/GST – Marshall Islands Gross Receipts Tax (GRT) limited to domestic commercial activity
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None – no VAT/GST registration regime; non-resident business corporations are not subject to local turnover-based registration
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing or real-time fiscal clearance mandate. No digital stamping, API-based reporting, or national e-invoicing infrastructure applies to non-resident business corporations.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Domestically, zero-rating is not applicable because no VAT is levied. For foreign VAT jurisdictions, the entity may claim 0% export VAT on goods or offshore services if it holds valid foreign VAT registration and provides proof of export or cross-border supply as required by the relevant foreign authority.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent export zero-rating claims are not actionable under Marshall Islands domestic law due to the absence of a VAT regime. If the entity asserts zero-rating in a foreign jurisdiction, penalties may include clawback of refunds, assessment of tax with interest, civil fraud penalties up to 100% of the understated tax, and criminal prosecution under the applicable foreign tax law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands has no central bank; the U.S. dollar is legal tender and the U.S. Federal Reserve acts as the de facto monetary authority. Banking and financial institution supervision is conducted by the Banking Commission of the Republic of the Marshall Islands under the Banking Act 1970.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Marshall Islands operates a fully dollarized economy with full current-account and capital-account convertibility. There are no exchange controls, no surrender requirements, and no restrictions on profit remittance or dividend distribution for non-resident business corporations. The practical constraints are not RMI legal restrictions but the AML/KYC and OFAC compliance policies of the U.S. correspondent banking network through which USD clearing must pass.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory export-proceeds surrender rules, mandatory conversion ratios, or repatriation timelines under Marshall Islands law. Export earnings may be freely retained in USD or other currencies in any licensed bank account. Commercial banks may nevertheless ask for proof of the underlying export transaction under AML/CTF obligations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / USD Business Transaction Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Offshore digital EMI services such as Wise B2B may be used as supplementary payment and payout channels for TikTok Shop retail settlement and supplier disbursements, but they are not substitute banks for statutory capital, treasury management, or commercial letters of credit because they do not hold full banking licences in RMI and are not recognised by the Banking Commission as depository institutions. Their use is legally permissible for e-commerce operating transactions, subject to completing the EMI's own KYC/AML review and to U.S. sanctions screening. The core operating account should remain with a RMI-licensed bank or a foreign bank with clear correspondent access.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is generally possible for a non-resident Marshall Islands Business Corporation if the bank accepts certified corporate documents, notarised resolutions, banker's references, and a live video interview with the beneficial owners and signatories. Physical attendance in the Republic of the Marshall Islands is not an absolute statutory requirement, but each bank retains policy discretion; where the shareholder structure is offshore or beneficial ownership layers create heightened risk, the bank may require a physical meeting at Majuro or a minimum presence of one director on screen with a local introducer. Directors should, therefore, be prepared either to travel or to engage an RMI-licensed corporate services provider as a support intermediary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident business corporation with no minimum capital, nominee directors, and purely offshore structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws; Certificate of Good Standing from the RMI Registrar; Certificate of Non-Resident Entity Status; register of directors and shareholders with full beneficial ownership disclosure; board resolution opening the account and appointing signatories; source-of-funds letter for the share capital; audited or management-accounts proof of the entity's genuine e-commerce activity; and explanatory statement of economic substance addressing RMI and OECD tax-transparency criteria.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume micro-payment flows originating from TikTok Shop social-commerce retail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid TikTok Shop seller registration and platform agreements; historical payout statements from TikTok; order-level or aggregated sales and refund data; supply and warehouse contracts; expected monthly volume and average ticket-size analysis; anti-money-laundering controls documentation; OFAC/PEP screening logs for counterparties; and reconciliation of payout currency conversions where applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of Wise B2B or other foreign EMIs as primary inbound/outbound clearing rails without an RMI-located account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: EMI's FATF or equivalent license and registration status; the EMI's most recent audited financial statements or prudential confirmation; contractual terms and safeguarding rules for customer funds; complete transactional trail vouched by invoices and lading or e-fulfilment evidence; a business rationale memorandum explaining why the RMI bank is not used for certain high-frequency, low-value payouts; and confirmation that all FX conversions are transparent and separately recorded.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital contributions should be remitted by each shareholder through a qualified bank using SWIFT MT103 or equivalent wire to the RMI bank's USD account at a U.S. correspondent. The Originator must identify the true beneficial owner; the Beneficiary must be the exact legal name of the Marshall Islands Business Corporation. Payment instructions should include 'PURPOSE: SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION – MH_BC' and a cross-reference to the subscription resolution. If the receiving bank requests, provide a share issuance certificate, board resolutions, and a copy of the filed corporate record. The funds should be routed only through OFAC-compliant correspondent banks, never through non-transparent intermediaries; same-day Fedwire/CHIPS settlement is acceptable for large capital injections.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements should be executed by SWIFT MT103 for direct supplier payments and by commercial letter of credit (MT700/MT800 issuance, MT202/MT754 amendments, and MT750/MT756 advices) for arranged imports. For low-value TikTok Shop operational disbursements, RMI banks may use USD ACH or local wire transfers to payouts, with Wise B2B used only for cross-border bulk payouts to foreign sellers and staff in currencies other than USD. All outbound payments must include the underlying invoice number, Harmonized System codes for merchandise, and a truthful payment description to avoid payment-coding refusals.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanilla FX forward contracts with a licensed RMI international bank or an OECD-based counterparty for matching non-USD supplier costs
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) with a regulated offshore bank for currencies without deliverable local markets
Cross-currency swaps with a licensed investment bank where the notional directly correlates with a contracted trade or capital obligation

Plain vanilla FX options for protection against adverse movements in a single foreign currency, provided that speculation is excluded and the instrument is documented as a hedge of a demonstrated exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Annual Franchise Tax Payment for Marshall Islands Business Corporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, submitted through the licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 30 April of each calendar year. If 30 April falls on a non-business day, the due date rolls forward to the next business day. A newly incorporated entity pays a pro-rated first annual fee with the formation invoice and the next renewal falls due on the following 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a 10% surcharge on the outstanding franchise tax after 30 April, with an additional 10% penalty accruing after 60 days. Failure to file the annual report and pay the franchise tax for two consecutive years permits the Registrar to administratively dissolve the corporation and strike it from the Register. Reinstatement requires payment of all arrears, penalties and the applicable reinstatement fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation accompanying the Annual Report and retained by the Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent acting as AML/CFT compliance officer; not filed in the public corporate registry unless specifically requested by the Registrar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be delivered to the Registered Agent concurrently with the annual report and in all events by 30 April of each year. Any transfer of shares or change of ultimate beneficial owner must be reported to the Registered Agent within 14 days after the transfer is recorded in the Register of Members.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or false UBO confirmation renders the annual compliance package incomplete; the Registered Agent is required to report repeated non-compliance to the Registrar. The Registrar may withhold a Certificate of Good Standing and impose administrative penalties through the agent, which contractually pass through to the corporation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Renewal Acknowledgment confirming officer, director and service-address details
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, filed through the outgoing or incoming Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually no later than 30 April. Notice of change of Registered Agent or Registered Office must be lodged before the annual renewal date; otherwise the current Registered Agent is deemed continued for the following statutory year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Outdated or invalid Registered Agent or office details will make service of process defective and may render the annual report deficient. The Registrar may decline to issue a Certificate of Good Standing and may initiate administrative strike-off after repeated statutory non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a privately held, non-resident Business Corporation whose securities are not listed and which is not a regulated bank, insurer, fund or trust. A compulsory independent audit may be triggered only by a board resolution, a court order on petition of shareholders holding at least 10% of voting power, or an application to admit securities to a regulated exchange.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act does not prescribe a domestic statutory GAAP for non-resident business corporations. The directors may lawfully adopt IFRS as issued by the IASB or US GAAP. If statutory financial statements are voluntarily prepared, they must present a true and fair view and be accompanied by a directors' statement.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed Registered Agent must identify and verify every individual who directly or indirectly owns at least 25% of the capital, voting rights or otherwise exercises ultimate control. An annual UBO confirmation is collected at the annual renewal date, and a fresh confirmation is required within 14 days after any share transfer. The Registered Agent retains UBO records for at least 7 years after the termination of the business relationship. No public beneficial ownership registry is maintained for this entity type in Marshall Islands.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$400 to US$1,150 per annum for a licensed Registered Agent, statutory registered office, document custody and annual report coordination. Additional AML compliance and economic substance services are billed separately.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No mandatory audit fee is incurred for this dormant or low-risk retail holding structure. If a voluntary IFRS audit is required by the board or a counterparty, the typical market fee is US$1,800 to US$3,500 plus disbursements.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) does not impose any corporate income tax, capital gains tax, franchise tax on profits, or business receipts tax. No statutory tax holiday or preferential deduction is available or necessary because the statutory rate on all income is zero. The only recurring public charge on a non-resident Business Corporation is the annual registration/license fee assessed under the Business Corporations Act, determined by authorized share capital (approximately US$50 up to 5,000 shares, US$150 up to 10,000 shares, US$250 up to 50,000 shares, US$350 up to 100,000 shares, US$400 up to 1,000,000 shares, US$500 up to 5,000,000 shares, US$1,500 up to 10,000,000 shares, and US$2,000 above 10,000,000 authorized shares). No income tax return exists for non-resident corporations and no tax on distributions, interest, royalties, or rents arises at the RMI level.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Report (official return designated by the RMI Registrar of Corporations); filed by the licensed RMI registered agent through the Office of the Registrar of Corporations electronic registry portal administered by International Registries, Inc., or by paper submission through the registered agent. There is no RMI corporate income tax return; the Annual Corporate Report is the sole periodic compliance filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Corporate Report and the accompanying annual registration fee are due on or before the anniversary date of incorporation in each calendar year. The registered agent coordinates the filing on the corporation's behalf. Late submission subjects the corporation to Registrar-imposed surcharges and, after a continued default period and statutory notice, administrative strike-off and dissolution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The corporate name exactly as set forth in the Articles of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact registered name; any name change must be effected by amendment to the Articles and reflected in the next Annual Report.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The unique file number issued by the RMI Registrar of Corporations at incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reference the Certificate of Compliance issued at incorporation; the number is required for all correspondence and payment processing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 3 — Registered Office in the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address of the registered office in the Marshall Islands at which legal process may be served.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident corporation is not required to maintain operating premises in RMI; the registered agent's RMI address may be stated as the registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 4 — Registered Agent Name and Address
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and RMI address of the licensed registered agent, which must be a natural person resident in RMI or a licensed corporate-services provider.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent files the Annual Report on behalf of the non-resident corporation; update this item promptly upon any change of agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names and residential or business addresses of all directors and officers; the Business Corporations Act requires a minimum of one officer and one director and permits natural persons of any nationality.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors and officers are permitted and common; provide accurate details for each individual serving during the reporting period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares, par value per share (if any), and class and series of shares; this figure determines the annual registration fee tier.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the authorized share count precisely to ensure correct fee assessment; the fee is calculated on authorized, not issued, capital.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of shares issued and outstanding and total consideration received; the corporation must maintain a confidential share register and beneficial ownership record with the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: RMI does not require public disclosure of beneficial owners in the Annual Report, but the registered agent must obtain and hold the beneficial ownership information under RMI law; ensure the share register is current.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 8 — Tax Residency and Economic Substance Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of whether the corporation is tax resident in any foreign jurisdiction; if so, the jurisdiction and foreign tax identification number; declaration of whether the corporation conducts a relevant activity under the RMI Economic Substance (Requirements) Regulations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident corporation engaged in TikTok Shop retail (distribution and service center business) must state its foreign tax-residency status. If the entity is managed and controlled in a foreign market, declare that jurisdiction and provide the foreign tax reference to support the economic-substance exclusion; a corporation tax-resident nowhere must complete full RMI economic-substance compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of the annual registration fee according to the authorized-share tier set by the Registrar, together with any applicable filing or penalty amounts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The fee must accompany the Annual Report; underpayment causes late-payment surcharge and default proceedings.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the Annual Corporate Report or to pay the annual registration fee by the anniversary date triggers: (i) surcharges as prescribed by the Registrar; (ii) after statutory notice, administrative strike-off and dissolution of the corporation; (iii) reinstatement costs and possible loss of the statutory limited-liability shield for obligations incurred after dissolution; and (iv) potential court-ordered liquidation upon continued default. A company that is struck off cannot lawfully transact business, hold assets, or maintain payment-rail accounts, and its directors become exposed for post-dissolution transactions.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the RMI imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by a Business Corporation to non-resident shareholders, whether individuals, corporations, or trusts. Dividends derived by a non-resident shareholder are outside RMI tax jurisdiction entirely.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI has not entered into any comprehensive double-taxation agreement (DTA) and maintains no administrative treaty-relief machinery, no Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) procedure, and no reduced-withholding-rate claim protocol at the RMI level. Because no RMI withholding tax exists at source, treaty relief is generally irrelevant for payments out of RMI. The practical protocol for an investor reliant on treaty benefits in a market jurisdiction is to (i) evidence RMI tax-exempt status with a Certificate of Status from the Registrar, (ii) document that the RMI entity is not a fiscal resident of the market state, and (iii) assert treaty protection, where available, through the foreign jurisdiction's own competent-authority procedure and by submitting a self-certification (W-8BEN-E or CRS equivalent) to the payment channel.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory RMI rates: 0% on cross-border royalties and 0% on interest paid to non-residents. No treaty rates apply because no income tax treaties are in force. Payments by a non-resident MH_BC to TikTok platform operators, brand licensors, or third-party lenders incur no RMI withholding tax; however, the paying entity must still verify the market jurisdiction's withholding exposure where the payment has a source nexus in the operating market.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — the RMI levies no income tax and maintains no transfer-pricing statute, no Local File, no Master File, no Country-by-Country Reporting obligation, and no local-currency documentation threshold. The USD-based threshold is therefore nil. If the MH_BC operates through a branch, agent, warehouse, or dependent intermediary in a foreign tax jurisdiction (e.g., the Philippines, Indonesia, or another market), that jurisdiction's transfer-pricing documentation thresholds (Master File, Local File, and CbC reporting) will apply to the foreign taxable presence and must be satisfied in that jurisdiction.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI Economic Substance (Requirements) Regulations 2020 impose an economic-substance test on non-resident domestic corporations carrying on relevant activities within the OECD Inclusive Framework's harmful-tax-practices scope. A TikTok Shop social-commerce retail operation engaged in purchasing goods and reselling through live commerce constitutes a Distribution and Service Center Business and is squarely a relevant activity. Applicability analysis: (1) the corporation is excluded from the full substance test only if it is tax resident in a foreign jurisdiction and subject to an appropriate foreign income tax on the relevant income; (2) if the MH_BC is a 'tax orphan' resident nowhere, it must satisfy in each financial year the directed-and-managed test and the adequacy test comprising physical presence, number of employees, and operating expenditure proportionate to the distribution activity, and must file an annual ESR return with the Registrar; (3) the 'pure holding' reduced-substance regime is unavailable because the entity is performing distribution; (4) outsourcing core income-generating activities to third parties in another jurisdiction is prohibited unless the RMI entity can supervise and control them. In addition, the RMI entity must demonstrate that it does not rely exclusively on foreign-affiliated service providers for its substance. The RMI Registrar administers penalties and can strike off non-compliant companies.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion Through Foreign Market Operations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a substantive TikTok Shop retail business — inventory in a foreign market, local fulfillment arrangements, TikTok Seller Center account registration, local influencers and marketing agreements, and settlement of sales proceeds through TikTok Shop Payout or Wise B2B — while relying solely on RMI tax-exempt status and failing to register, file, or settle corporate income tax, VAT/GST, or withholding taxes in the market jurisdiction; or artificially suppressing recorded revenue in the market by diverting settlements to nominee accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The market jurisdiction's revenue authority may reassess the entity for back taxes covering 3 to 10 years (depending on the statute of limitations), impose statutory interest, failure-to-file penalties, failure-to-pay penalties, and late VAT/GST penalties, and refer the matter for criminal tax-evasion prosecution where intent is shown. RMI itself imposes no tax sanction because it has no income tax; RMI consult tax-exempt status confers no exemption from foreign tax laws and cannot be asserted as a defense to foreign assessment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and controlling shareholders who sign false returns, cause settlement funds to be diverted to shell accounts, or knowingly operate through an unregistered permanent establishment may be personally liable for the unpaid foreign tax under civil-assessments provisions of the market jurisdiction, and foreign courts may issue travel bans, asset-freeze orders, and extradition requests. Conviction for tax fraud in the market jurisdiction can lead to imprisonment of the natural-person directors. The RMI corporate veil will not shield deliberate concealment or fraud, and RMI courts will cooperate with foreign letters rogatory in asset-recovery proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the MH_BC as a shell with nominee directors, no employees, no physical operating presence, no foreign tax residence, and no ESR filing, while representing RMI tax-exempt status to payment processors and transaction counterparties and carrying on a distribution activity that is not excluded from the RMI Economic Substance (Requirements) Regulations 2020.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The RMI Registrar may levy administrative penalties prescribed under the ESR Regulations — commonly up to US$20,000 per contravention with continued daily default penalties on repeated failures — and may compel delivery of ESR returns, financial statements, and records of substance. Continued non-compliance leads to strike-off and dissolution of the corporation, involuntary cancellation of the Certificate of Good Standing, and loss of access to payment rails such as TikTok Shop Payout and Wise B2B, which require an active, good-standing corporate status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly cause or permit a materially false ESR declaration, or who intentionally strip the entity of substance to manufacture an exclusion, commit a public offense under RMI law exposing them to personal fines and imprisonment (up to 5 years in aggravated fraudulent cases). RMI courts may pierce the corporate veil on equitable grounds to impose civil restitution, order disqualification of directors from serving on any RMI company, and issue travel-restraint orders where the director attempts to flee the jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach and Beneficial Ownership Non-Disclosure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using anonymous or layered nominee shareholders, failing to disclose ultimate beneficial owners to the licensed registered agent as required by RMI beneficial-ownership obligations, obscuring the source of funds routed through TikTok Shop Payout and Wise B2B, or processing settlements through accounts that defeat traceability under the Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism (Prevention) Act 2012.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The RMI Financial Intelligence Unit may impose fines prescribed under the Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism (Prevention) Act — for corporations, monetary penalties up to US$1,000,000 per violation, and for individuals up to US$100,000 per violation; the Registrar may suspend the registered agent, the company may be struck off, and correspondent banks and licensed payment institutions may terminate the entity's accounts and file suspicious transaction reports. Failure to maintain beneficial ownership records is itself an offense subject to separate penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual directors and officers who knowingly supply false beneficial-ownership information or who facilitate layering or laundering of retail proceeds face criminal prosecution carrying custodial sentences (in aggravated cases up to 10 years per offense), as well as civil confiscation proceedings, freezing orders, and travel bans. Personal criminal liability attaches to the natural perpetrators regardless of the corporation's separate legal personality, and the RMI courts will order restitution of laundered assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Annual Report and Filing Misrepresentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing an Annual Corporate Report that contains false statements as to the names or addresses of directors and officers, authorized or issued share capital, the registered office, or the corporation's tax-residency and economic-substance declaration; or knowingly making an ESR return that misstates the place of effective management and control in order to claim a foreign tax-residence exclusion that the entity does not in fact satisfy.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Business Corporations Act, knowingly making a false statement in any report or document filed with the Registrar constitutes an offense punishable by fine and/or imprisonment as determined by the RMI High Court. The Registrar may strike off the company, impose default surcharges, and issue damaging public notices; counterparties and lenders may bring civil claims for deceit where the false annual report induced credit or contractual performance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director and officer who signs, certifies, or causes a false filing is personally liable for fines, civil restitution, and the company's unpaid debts where the misrepresentation induced third-party reliance; the RMI courts may disqualify the individual from serving as a director or officer of any RMI-registered company, impose orders restricting departure from the Marshall Islands pending adjudication, and facilitate foreign enforcement through letters rogatory and mutual legal-assistance instruments.
